task.description: Validate test designs from Step 03 REWORK 1. The TEST-DESIGNER has addressed all 6 issues from the previous review. Verify: (1) every MUST requirement now has a runnable integration test file, (2) no error.SkipZigTest on MUST tests without counterpart integration test, (3) all fixtures use per-test UUIDs, (4) tests clean up after themselves, (5) tests fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent. Hard gate -- TEST-RUNNER cannot start until PASS.
acceptance_criteria: All ISS-601 MUST requirements have runnable integration tests (including TC-601-02, TC-601-05, TC-601-08 full path)
All ISS-602 MUST requirements have runnable tests (including TC-602-03, TC-602-06)
No error.SkipZigTest on MUST tests without counterpart
Tests are self-sufficient and fail clearly without BPM_TEST_DB_URL

result.summary: All 6 issues from the previous review are resolved. BLOCKER: TC-ISS-601-02 (delta reconstruction at seq 25) exists and validates snapshot-assisted delta path vs full replay. BLOCKER: TC-ISS-601-05 (overflow payload COALESCE join) creates event_payloads_overflow table, seeds large payload, takes snapshot at seq 1, reconstructs via delta. MAJOR: TC-ISS-602-03 (cutover gate regression) verifies no expr import on engine path via @embedFile static analysis. MAJOR: TC-ISS-602-06 (unsupported features) tests has(), all(), exists(), size(), matches(), int(), string(), list comprehensions, map literals, ternary -- all return null. MAJOR: ISS-601 NFR-04 benchmark measures 100k-event snapshot-assisted delta replay with target <=1s via measureReplayWithSnapshotsMs. MINOR: TC-ISS-601-08 (multi-boundary) creates 2500 events with snapshots at seq 1000 and 2000. All tests use per-test UUIDs, have defer cleanup, and fail clearly when BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent. No error.SkipZigTest on MUST tests without counterpart.
